Logistics and distribution bottlenecks (OILS, PSDN) will persist as infrastructure gaps widen, pressuring margins for companies reliant on fragmented supply chains despite top-line growth.
sectors.ai: Aggregate consumer/FMCG weakness masks sharp divergence: buy the 6+% gainers (AGAR, KLIN, TFCO, SOSS, FLMC) as they signal rotation into niche staples and specialty chemicals with pricing power. Short OILS and PSDN on margin compression from input cost pass-through delays. The ALERT flags sector-wide de-rating, but selective longs on high-momentum names can capture alpha before Q3 earnings confirm resilience.
